item.title: Monaco Biennale to spotlight paediatric cancer breakthroughs and AI innovation
item.description: The 17ᵗʰ Biennale Monégasque de Cancérologie will return to the Grimaldi Forum with a landmark focus on paediatric oncology and artificial intelligence in cancer care.

item.title: Women’s rights in Monaco: A snapshot of progress and challenges in 2025
item.description: Monaco's gender violence victims ranged from age 6 to 80 in 2025, with reported cases rising from 35 to 40, the Committee for the Promotion and Protection of Women's Rights revealed Tuesday.

item.title: Von der Leyen declares era of European independence as Trump’s threats mount
item.description: Speaking on Tuesday, von der Leyen framed the current geopolitical upheaval not as a crisis to be weathered, but as a permanent shift requiring permanent European transformation.

item.title: Football: Kylian Mbappé and Real Madrid subject Monaco to historic defeat
item.description: AS Monaco suffered their heaviest defeat in European football at the hands of Real Madrid on a sombre night for the Principality club (6-1) at the Bernabéu.

item.title: Airbnb liable for illegal subletting on its platform in France
item.description: France's highest court has ruled that Airbnb can be held financially responsible when users illegally sublet properties through its platform without landlord permission.

item.title: Interview: Playwright Adam Rapp on provocation, perseverance, and the power of the Princess Grace legacy
item.description: From Broadway to Steppenwolf, and from Illinois cornfields to imagined days in Monaco, Rapp reminds us why stories that unsettle us are often the ones we need most.

item.title: Monaco launches ‘Parlons Sciences’ lecture series to make science accessible to all
item.description: A new monthly lecture series aims to bring scientific knowledge out of the laboratory and into public conversation in Monaco.

item.title: Monaco to host first-ever energy storage forum to position principality as innovation hub
item.description: It marks the principality's bid to establish itself as a strategic European hub for clean energy technology and grid innovation.

item.title: Monaco symposium aims to transform polar science into solutions
item.description: Hundreds of polar researchers will descend on Monaco next month as the principality hosts the third Monaco Polar Symposium, an event increasingly focused on moving beyond data collection to practical solutions.

item.title: Monaco’s hot air balloon team sets sight on Alpine tour and Channel crossing
item.description: The Monaco Ballooning Team has announced an ambitious programme for 2026, including participation in a record-breaking attempt to cross the English Channel with 200 balloons.
